title: Gold falls below $4,300 as higher US yields bolster Fed rate hike bets
summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) tumbles to near $4,295 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure as rising bond yields and surging energy prices strengthen expectations that the US Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise interest rates this week.

title: US repeals rules limiting greenhouse gas emissions by power plants
summary: The Trump administration says it could save power plants more than $300bn and unleash American energy.
